requirement: `habeas setup` MUST preserve existing entries in `output.html.additional-css` while adding the Habeas stylesheet at most once. It MUST report an error if `additional-css` is not an array.
rationale:
The tests cover each obligation in `requirements.cli.setup_css`.

- **Preserve existing entries.** The `fixture` in `tests/setup.rs` writes `additional-css = ["md/custom.css"]`. `tests/setup.rs#fn[setup_is_repeatable]` runs `habeas setup` and asserts that `book.toml` still contains `md/custom.css` and also contains `md/habeas.css`.
- **Add the stylesheet at most once.** The same test runs setup twice on the same project. It asserts `book.matches("md/habeas.css").count() == 1`, so a second run that appended a duplicate would fail.
- **Error when `additional-css` is not an array.** `tests/setup.rs#fn[setup_rejects_invalid_book_configuration]` writes `additional-css = "wrong"`. It asserts that the command fails and that stderr contains "output.html.additional-css must be an array".

Both tests carry `{test}` references to `requirements.cli.setup_css`, so there is no marking gap. I found no other behavior in the requirement text that these tests miss.
